title: CBIC ne Jaari Kiye Naye GST Notifications: RCM, Registration, aur TDS mein Badlav 1st November 2026 Se!
content:
# CBIC ne Jaari Kiye Naye GST Notifications: RCM, Registration, aur TDS mein Badlav 1st November 2026 Se!

Ek important update hai. Government ne Goods and Services Tax (GST) regulations mein kuch significant changes announce kiye hain, jo 1st November 2026 se effective honge. Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) ne is sambandh mein kai naye notifications aur circulars jaari kiye hain.

Yeh changes Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM), GST Registration process, aur Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) provisions ko impact karenge. Business owners aur tax professionals ke liye in badlavon ko samajhna bahut zaroori hai.

### Key Changes Jo Aapko Pata Hone Chahiye:

*   **Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM) ka Vistaar:** Ab RCM kuch nirdisht waste aur scrap items par bhi applicable hoga. Ismein used cooking oil, plastic waste, tyre waste, metal scrap (Chapters 72 se 81 tak), aur electrical & electronic waste shaamil hain. Yeh badlav Notification No. 07/2026-Central Tax dated 27th October, 2026 ke through kiya gaya hai, jo Notification No. 50/2018-Central Tax mein sanshodhan karta hai.
*   **Registration Process mein Sudhaar:**
    *   **Naye Guidelines:** Circular No. 257/03/2026-GST dated 26th October, 2026 ne GST registration applications ko process karne ke liye detailed guidelines provide kiye hain. Iska maksad registration process ko streamline karna, zaruri documents ko clear karna aur approval ke liye timelines set karna hai, jismein 'deemed approval' ka provision bhi shaamil hai.
    *   **E-commerce Sellers ke liye Naya Option:** Notification No. 05/2026-Central Tax dated 26th October, 2026 ke zariye Central Goods and Services Tax (Amendment) Rules, 2026 mein Rule 14B introduce kiya gaya hai. Is naye rule se eligible e-commerce sellers doosre states ya union territories mein registration le sakte hain, jahan unki physical presence nahi hai, sirf electronic commerce operator ke warehouse ko apna principal place of business declare karke.
    *   **Cancellation Rules mein Badlav:** GST registration cancel karne ke liye Rule 20 ko bhi revise kiya gaya hai, jo 1st November 2026 se effective hoga.
*   **TDS Provisions mein Badlav:** Specified waste aur scrap categories par GST-TDS ke provisions mein bhi changes kiye gaye hain. Ismein used cooking oil, plastic waste and scrap, tyre waste and scrap, metal scrap (Chapters 72 to 81), aur electrical & electronic waste shaamil hain. Yeh amendment bhi Notification No. 07/2026-Central Tax dated 27th October, 2026 ke through kiya gaya hai.

Yeh updates compliance burden kam karne aur tax administration ko behtar banane ki disha mein ek kadam hain. Businesses ko salaah di jaati hai ki woh in badlavon ko dhyan se padhein aur apni internal processes ko uske according adjust karein.
